items.markdown:
If you’re looking for a **blue Staffordshire Bull Terrier (“Staffy”) puppy around London**, I’d prioritise a responsible, health-tested breeder rather than buying based on colour or an online advert.

A few London-area listings came up in the search, including:

- Staffordshire Bull Terrier Puppy Breeder — Plumstead, southeast London.
- [Elite Staffy Puppies](https://ukstaffypups.uk/staffy-puppies-for-sale) — Canary Wharf/London [postcode removed].
- Blue Staffordshire BullTerrier puppies — listed specifically for blue Staffies.

**I wouldn't treat those listings as endorsements**, though. Before paying a deposit, independently check the breeder, licence status where applicable, health certificates and the puppy's parents.

### What to ask the breeder

For a Staffy, specifically ask:

- **Can I see the puppy with its mother, at the place where it was raised?** Don't accept excuses about meeting somewhere else.
- **Are both parents registered, and can I see their KC registration details?**
- **Have both parents been DNA tested for L-2-HGA and hereditary cataracts (HC-HSF4-2)?** These are specifically identified by the Kennel Club's current Staffordshire Bull Terrier health guidance. [The Kennel Club](https://www.thekennelclub.org.uk/media/cvef530x/kc_health_standard_07-25-web.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **Can I see the original test certificates/results?** Don't rely on a breeder simply saying "DNA clear."
- **Have the parents had eye testing and elbow testing?** The Kennel Club's current best-practice guidance includes eye and elbow testing in addition to the DNA tests. [The Kennel Club](https://www.thekennelclub.org.uk/media/cvef530x/kc_health_standard_07-25-web.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **Why did you choose these two dogs to breed together?** A good breeder should be able to explain temperament, health and pedigree considerations.
- **How old is the puppy, and when can it leave its mother?**
- **What vaccinations, microchip and worming has it had?**
- **What food is it currently eating, and what socialisation has it received?**
- **Can I have a written contract and a receipt?**
- **Will you take the dog back or help rehome it if I can no longer keep it?**

### One thing about "blue" Staffies

Blue is a recognised Staffordshire Bull Terrier colour under the current Kennel Club standard, so **blue itself isn't evidence that the puppy is unhealthy or a crossbreed**. [The Kennel Club](https://www.thekennelclub.org.uk/media/o4fhe5lf/nov-25-kcj-final-online-1.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com) 

However, I'd be wary of breeders marketing puppies primarily as **"rare blue," "blue & tan," "XL Staffy,"** etc., or charging a large premium purely for colour. Health, temperament and responsible breeding are much more important.

If you want, I can also **search specifically for reputable/registered Staffy breeders within, say, 30–50 miles of London and give you a shortlist with their websites, licences/health testing and current puppy availability**.
